evidence.observation: Pressure rose steadily during growth: 2.998 → 3.072 → 3.135 → 3.212 Torr, while Ar flow held at about 100 sccm
Exhaust O2 rose from 5-8 ppm during the ramp to 8.9 → 10.1 → 18.2 → 24.3 ppm, so outside air is getting in
Ar flow matches setpoint (99.9 sccm), so the MFC is not the cause of the pressure rise
Temperature is holding at 750.0 °C with heater power at 45%, so the thermal side looks normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate check (isolate the tube and watch how fast pressure rises) would confirm a seal leak rather than an exhaust blockage. A blockage would raise pressure without adding O2. Normal-run reference values would also help size how far P and O2 are off.
